content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause starting with "Completeness of work product shall be determined by REIT in its sole discretion...": You are required to make an unlimited number of revisions and changes requested by the client based on their sole discretion, without any additional pay or limit on rounds. I suggest the following modification: The Client may request up to three (3) rounds of revisions to the deliverables, provided that such requests are made within fourteen (14) days of delivery and do not alter the agreed scope of work. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
